script_modal.title: Call script
script_modal.body:
1. Warm opening: "Hi, I'm calling from Mehamakor — is now a good time?"
2. Brief intro: "An Israeli site that connects local businesses with shoppers looking for high-quality food."
3. Value proposition: "Free to sign up, your profile gets published, and you receive customer inquiries directly via WhatsApp."
4. Open question: "How does that sound?"
5. If interested: "Great! I'll send you a link with all your details ready — just confirm a password."
6. If declining: "No problem, thanks for your time. If you change your mind, our address is mehamakor.online."
7. To close: "Have a great day."

warm.title: Warm
warm.body:
Hi {name} 🌿
I saw your work and I really love what you do. I'm with Mehamakor — a site that connects small business owners with shoppers looking for real, local food.
You're invited to join us, free of charge — just click the link and your details are waiting:
{prefillUrl}
